[wetsandwich] As someone who doesn't "get" football, I might actually consider this. No idea what to do once I get in there and sit down though
[ikt] Complete Guide to Football:
Step 1: Arrive
Step 2: Find your seat
Step 3: Sit in your seat
Step 4: Look outward towards the field
Step 5: Follow the play on the field and look up at the Giant TV screens to keep you up to date on the score and watch the replays of exciting action!
Step 6: Keep doing this for until it's half time (you'll know it's half time because lots of people will get up and start walking back at the same time
Step 7: Buy a hotdog and coke*
Step 8: Walk back to your seat
Step 9: Eat hotdog and drink coke while watching match
Step 10: When game is over walk out and go home (you'll know it's the end of the match because the majority of people will get up at the same time and walk out)
*Food and/or drink of your choice, if you aren't hungry browsing web on phone or chatting to people around you is always something that can be considered
**You can also get food at the start of the match or at any point during the match if you wish
Enjoy a free day out in the sun :)
nb: I do recommend looking up some of the basic rules and regulations of the game on youtube so you have somewhat of an idea of what you're looking at
